scope: Deterministic bounded-work and storage checks plus a fixed-source local Debug real-Parquet comparison during concurrent validation.
collector_git_head_note: The report git_head identifies the collector workspace. The baseline executable predates it; baseline_binary_source is its separately frozen actual build source.
plan_identity_note: Full plan hashes include each isolated local fixture URI. The two runtime plans compare equal after removing only that URI; verified source and normalized workload hashes match.

conclusions.answers: All 48 samples pass both normalized complete-answer comparison and independently expected application IDs; all four cases retain 21 decorated candidates.
conclusions.timing: Warm medians are 27.6-29.9 ms versus 27.1-29.0 ms. Restarted medians are 153.7-215.1 ms versus 154.5-213.5 ms. Runs overlap native/E2E validation; no end-to-end latency improvement is attributed to these refinements.
conclusions.scope: All-match query controls preserve bounded native sorting. Interleaved partial-term reader reuse and compact refresh state are qualified separately by deterministic native tests.
conclusions.compatibility: Historical JSON ordering rows coexist with new typed binary rows; protocol 87 fences older writers. Existing native serving formats, current authority checks and exact fallback remain intact.

lineage_page_leases.scope: Operation-owned immutable cache leases; newly acquired pages consume logical read budget. These are not measured network bytes.

term_probe_lru.scope: Partial single-term memberships retain query-owned segment leases and posting chunks; init and chunk allocation pressure preserve exact bitmap fallback.

ordering_codec.encoding: AFOK001 plus exact input version and tagged native values
ordering_codec.scope: Deterministic serialized row fixture; not an archive-wide storage ratio.

oracle.derivation: The fixed plan retains independently derived expected application IDs for every case. The collector verifies local Parquet content around launches and before completion. Compare also checks normalized complete answers.

comparison.environment_scope: same declared platform and collector; sequential runs are observational, not randomized paired trials
